court: In the High Court of Madras
case_number: TR CMP No. 162 of 2026 and CMP No. 5374 of 2026
advocates: For Respondent(s): Ms. J. Bhuvaneshwari For M/s. S. Phoenix Legal Attorneys
judgment_text:
PRAYER To withdraw and transfer HMOP. No. 3583 of 2025 pending before the Honble I Additional Family Court of Madras to the Honble Family Court of Madurai, and pass such other order as this Honble Court may deem fit and proper and thus render justice.

The Order of the Court was delivered by

T.V. Thamilselvi, J.:— This Transfer Civil Miscellaneous Petition has been filed seeking to withdraw and transfer HMOP. No. 3583 of 2025 pending before the I Additional Family Court of Madras to the Family Court of Madurai.

2. Both side counsels appeared.

3. The learned counsel for the petitioner seeks permission of this Court to withdraw this petition and made an endorsement to that effect. Accordingly, this Transfer Civil Miscellaneous Petition is dismissed as withdrawn.
